TL;DR: MonsterHouse is an interactive projection I created for Halloween. He listens to trick-or-treaters, answers in the voice of a grumpy old pirate ship and softens when visitors remember their manners. He is built on the NVIDIA Nemotron Voice Agent with NVIDIA Nemotron ASR , Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB , Magpie TTS Zeroshot and Audio2Face-3D , and he runs on a single workstation.

stories.title: AI 支出担忧引发美股科技股连日下跌，Intel 盘中跌逾 30% / US tech stocks see sharp falls over AI cost fears

sources.summary: BBC 报道称，因担忧企业对 AI 的巨额投资回报，美股科技股连续第二日大跌。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以Intel单日一度跌30%、Nasdaq跌超3.5%和Alphabet市值蒸发逾5000亿美元为例，说明AI高投入与盈利预期错位正引发科技股抛售。

en.summary: BBC reports that US tech stocks fell for a second straight day amid concerns over the returns on companies' massive AI investments.
en.reason: Intel’s one-day fall of as much as 30%, Nasdaq’s over-3.5% drop and more than $500 billion erased from Alphabet’s market value show AI spending fears driving a second straight tech selloff.

stories.title: Reddit CEO 称 Google AI Mode 不为任何人带来流量，Reddit 每周流失超百万搜索访问 / Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web

sources.title: Reddit CEO 称 Google AI Mode 不为任何人带来流量，Reddit 每周流失超百万搜索访问 / Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_zh: Reddit CEO 称 Google AI Mode 不为任何人带来流量，Reddit 每周流失超百万搜索访问
sources.title_en: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.title_original: Google's AI Mode doesn't drive traffic "for anybody," Reddit CEO Huffman warns the entire web
sources.summary: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman 表示 10 月 Reddit 每周流失超过 100 万来自 Google 搜索的访问，股价在业绩强劲的情况下仍下跌超 25%。他称 AI Mode 不会带来流量，Reddit 正在美国以外测试登录墙以遏制抓取，并与 AI 提供商继续数据授权谈判。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Reddit 10月每周流失超100万次Google搜索引荐、股价跌逾25%，Steve Huffman称AI Mode不导流，警告所有依赖搜索流量的业务。

en.summary: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman said Reddit was losing more than 1 million Google Search visits per week in October, and its shares fell over 25% despite strong results. He said AI Mode won't bring traffic, Reddit is testing a login wall outside the US to curb scraping, and it is continuing data licensing talks with AI providers.
en.reason: Reddit lost more than 1 million weekly Google search referrals in October and its stock fell over 25% despite strong earnings, as CEO Steve Huffman said AI Mode drives no traffic and warned every business relying on search traffic.

sources.title: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络 / What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.title_zh: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络
sources.title_en: What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.title_original: What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.summary: Casey Newton 分析 Google 与 Reddit 同日遭遇的股市重挫：Alphabet 股价跌 12.6%，蒸发约 $5000 亿市值，为史上第二大单日市值缩水；高管承认 AI Mode 变现能力低于传统搜索，尽管 AI Mode 月用户约 10 亿、搜索收入仍增长 12% 至 $633.5 亿。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet单日跌12.6%、市值蒸发约5000亿美元，Reddit跌15%且搜索流量下滑，原文借此说明Google的AI Mode比传统搜索更不赚钱。

en.summary: Casey Newton analyzes the same-day stock market rout that hit Google and Reddit: Alphabet shares fell 12.6%, wiping out roughly $500 billion in market value—the second-largest single-day market cap loss in history. Executives acknowledged that AI Mode monetizes worse than traditional search, even though AI Mode has about 1 billion monthly users and search revenue still grew 12% to $63.35 billion.
en.reason: Alphabet fell 12.6%, shedding $500 billion—the second-largest single-day loss ever—and Reddit dropped 15% as executives conceded AI Mode, with roughly 1 billion monthly users, monetizes worse than traditional search despite search revenue rising 12% to $63.35 billion.

stories.title: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox / AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update

sources.title: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox / AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
sources.title_zh: Epoch AI 实验显示 GLM 5.3 可利用补丁窗口期自主攻击 Firefox
sources.title_en: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
sources.title_original: AI can turn public security fixes into working exploits before users receive an update
sources.summary: Epoch AI 实验发现，Z.ai 八月发布的开源权重模型 GLM 5.3 能利用 Mozilla 已发布但未推送给用户的安全补丁（patch gap），自主构建网页攻击，仅访问页面即可读取访客电脑文件，攻破 9 月 17 日至 10 月 26 日发布的全部六个 Firefox 版本。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 实验显示，Z.ai 的 GLM 5.3 仅用约 $1,000 算力，从 Mozilla 已发布未推送的修复中逆向漏洞，最快 12 小时让 Firefox 用户仅访问网页即泄露文件。

en.summary: Epoch AI experiments found that GLM 5.3, the open-weight model Z.ai released in August, can exploit security patches Mozilla has published but not yet pushed to users (the patch gap) to autonomously build web attacks that read files on a visitor’s computer just by visiting a page, compromising all six Firefox versions released between September 17 and October 26.
en.reason: Epoch AI found Z.ai's GLM 5.3 used about $1,000 of compute to reverse-engineer Mozilla's published-but-unshipped Firefox patches into web attacks in as little as 12 hours, breaking all six versions released September 17 to October 26 and reading visitors' files.

stories.title: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应 / This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
stories.source: X：Philipp Schmid（Google DeepMind 开发者体验） (@_philschmid)

sources.title: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应 / This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
sources.title_zh: Project Suncatcher 在轨道卫星上运行 TPU，Gemma 模型首次在太空完成推理并回传回应
sources.title_en: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
sources.title_original: This incredible. Gemma 4 became the first LLM to run in space?
sources.summary: Philipp Schmid 转引 Sundar Pichai 的消息：Google Project Suncatcher 在数周前发射原型卫星后，成功向轨道发送指令、启动 TPU、运行提示词，并在地面收到了首个完整回应（一首 haiku），作者称 Gemma 4 成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 标题称Gemma 4成为首个在太空运行的大语言模型，但正文仅重复该标题并附"查看最新动态并加入对话"提示，未给出任务名称、硬件或验证细节，读者可据此判断信息量。
sources.source: X：Philipp Schmid（Google DeepMind 开发者体验） (@_philschmid)

en.summary: Philipp Schmid, citing Sundar Pichai: weeks after launching a prototype satellite, Google's Project Suncatcher successfully sent commands to orbit, powered up a TPU, ran a prompt, and received the first full response back on the ground (a haiku). The author says Gemma 4 is now the first large language model to run in space.
en.reason: Google's Project Suncatcher reportedly sent commands to a prototype satellite, booted a TPU in orbit and received a haiku from Gemma 4, which Philipp Schmid calls the first LLM run in space — though the post offers few verification details.

sources.summary: Anthropic 将 Claude 订阅套餐更名：Max 5x 改为 Max，Max 20x 改为 Ultra，价格不变（Max 100 美元/月、Ultra 200 美元/月）。即日起多数老订阅者的认证 Ultra 账号取消 5 小时限制，新账号保留临时限制以防欺诈滥用，周限额不变。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Max20 正式改名为 Ultra，价格与总体额度不变，但已验证账户取消 5 小时使用限制，官方以一句 Happy building 简短公布这则更新。
sources.source: X：Ado Kukic（Anthropic 开发者关系，Claude Code） (@adocomplete)

en.summary: Anthropic is renaming its Claude subscription tiers: Max 5x becomes Max and Max 20x becomes Ultra, with prices unchanged ($100/month for Max, $200/month for Ultra). Effective today, most existing subscribers with verified Ultra accounts will have the 5-hour limit lifted; new accounts keep a temporary limit to prevent fraud and abuse, and weekly limits remain unchanged.
en.reason: Anthropic renamed its Claude subscription tiers so Max 5x becomes Max and Max 20x becomes Ultra, with prices unchanged at $100 and $200 per month, while most existing verified Ultra accounts lose the 5-hour usage limit and new accounts keep a temporary cap to prevent fraud, though weekly limits stay the same.

items.summary: Anthropic 将 Claude 订阅套餐更名：Max 5x 改为 Max，Max 20x 改为 Ultra，价格不变（Max 100 美元/月、Ultra 200 美元/月）。即日起多数老订阅者的认证 Ultra 账号取消 5 小时限制，新账号保留临时限制以防欺诈滥用，周限额不变。
items.recommend_reason_zh: Max20 正式改名为 Ultra，价格与总体额度不变，但已验证账户取消 5 小时使用限制，官方以一句 Happy building 简短公布这则更新。
items.source: X：Ado Kukic（Anthropic 开发者关系，Claude Code） (@adocomplete)

en.summary: Anthropic is renaming its Claude subscription tiers: Max 5x becomes Max and Max 20x becomes Ultra, with prices unchanged ($100/month for Max, $200/month for Ultra). Effective today, most existing subscribers with verified Ultra accounts will have the 5-hour limit lifted; new accounts keep a temporary limit to prevent fraud and abuse, and weekly limits remain unchanged.
en.reason: Anthropic renamed its Claude subscription tiers so Max 5x becomes Max and Max 20x becomes Ultra, with prices unchanged at $100 and $200 per month, while most existing verified Ultra accounts lose the 5-hour usage limit and new accounts keep a temporary cap to prevent fraud, though weekly limits stay the same.

en.title: Fable 5.5 tests reveal: behind every Claude response, an invisible “safety trial” is quietly running
en.reason: Test feedback on Anthropic's Fable5.5 (or Opus5.5) shows it fixing bugs and tracing underlying architecture risks in coding tests, while the piece dissects a Self-Assessment mechanism that runs a hidden review after each Claude answer.

stories.title: Andy Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元营收业务，2026 年资本开支约 2200 亿美元 / AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.

sources.title: Andy Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元营收业务，2026 年资本开支约 2200 亿美元 / AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
sources.title_zh: Andy Jassy 称 AWS 将成为万亿美元营收业务，2026 年资本开支约 2200 亿美元
sources.title_en: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
sources.title_original: AWS will be a $1T business, Jassy says. But first, it will spend big.
sources.summary: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Jassy 称 AWS 将成为 1 万亿美元业务，并让 Amazon 成为首家 1 万亿美元营收公司，但前提是继续大举资本开支。

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.
en.reason: Andy Jassy says AWS can become a $1 trillion annual-revenue business in five to ten years, while Amazon plans about $220 billion in 2026 cash capex, mostly for AWS, after AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate.

primary_item.summary: 亚马逊财报电话会上，CEO Andy Jassy 重申 AWS 可在未来五到十年成为万亿美元年营收业务，预计 2026 年现金资本开支约 2200 亿美元，其中大部分投向 AWS，2027 年还将大幅增加。AWS 当季营收同比增长 39%，年化营收运行率达 1840 亿美元，Jassy 预测 2027 和 2028 年增速均可超 40%；财报后盘后交易中亚马逊股价下跌约 6%。
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Jassy 称 AWS 将成为 1 万亿美元业务，并让 Amazon 成为首家 1 万亿美元营收公司，但前提是继续大举资本开支。

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. He expects about $220 billion in cash capex in 2026, most of it going to AWS, with a substantial increase again in 2027. AWS revenue grew 39% year over year in the quarter, with an annualized run rate of $184 billion, and Jassy expects growth to exceed 40% in both 2027 and 2028. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.
en.reason: Andy Jassy says AWS can become a $1 trillion annual-revenue business in five to ten years, while Amazon plans about $220 billion in 2026 cash capex, mostly for AWS, after AWS grew 39% to a $184 billion run rate.

stories.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

sources.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.title_zh: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑
sources.title_en: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.title_original: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布将转向以登录为主的体验，以保护数据免受 AI 抓取并提升广告变现。10 月搜索流量平均每周减少超 100 万次引荐，Q3 全球日活为 1.303 亿，其中美国日活降至 5070 万，同比降 2%。Q3 收入同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润 2.83 亿美元；该转变将先在美国以外市场测试，暂无全球上线时间表。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道解释了 Reddit 为何在搜索流量枯竭、AI 改变人们在线找信息方式的背景下宣布转向 logged-in experience，并重新思考开放网络根基以保护受众和业务。

en.summary: Reddit announced in its Q3 earnings that it will shift to a login-first experience to protect its data from AI scraping and improve ad monetization. In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.
en.reason: Reddit will test a logged-in experience outside the U.S. first to block AI scraping and boost ad monetization after October search referrals fell by more than 1 million weekly, even as Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895 million.

sources.title_zh: OpenRouter 实测 Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku 5.5 该选哪个
sources.title_en: Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Which Should You Use?
sources.title_original: Claude Opus vs Sonnet vs Haiku: Which Should You Use?
sources.summary: OpenRouter 实测 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 与 Haiku 5.5 三档模型，建议默认用 Sonnet 5.5，高频与子智能体任务用 Haiku 5.5，长且容错成本高的任务用 Opus 5.5。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5和Haiku 5.5跑同样的11个编码任务，三者全过，但成本相差30倍，因此建议多数团队默认用Sonnet 5.5。

en.summary: OpenRouter tested Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, recommending Sonnet 5.5 as the default, Haiku 5.5 for high-frequency and sub-agent tasks, and Opus 5.5 for long tasks where the cost of errors is high.
en.reason: OpenRouter tested Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 on 11 coding tasks: all passed, but costs varied 30x, so Sonnet 5.5 is the default, Haiku 5.5 suits frequent/subagent work, and Opus 5.5 long, high-error-cost tasks.

stories.title: Kimi 官方教程：如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品

sources.title: Kimi 官方教程：如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品
sources.title_zh: Kimi 官方教程：如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品
sources.title_original: Kimi 官方教程：如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品
sources.summary: 月之暗面（Kimi）发布官方教程，详解 Kimi K3.1 Pro 的 3D 创作工作流程，说明参数化建模与网格化建模两种方式及对应工具选择。文章分享了 4 个案例的具体操作，包括在 Unreal Engine 中构建东方天宫、制作可 3D 打印的台灯、纯代码调用 Blender 生成建筑、用 Tripo 和 Blender 搭建微缩城市，并给出图胜于言、先搭灰模再细化等 5 个使用技巧。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Kimi 官方发布的教程，围绕如何用 Kimi K3.1 Pro 创作 3D 作品展开，想尝试 AI 生成 3D 内容的人可以照着官方步骤上手。

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.
en.reason: Kimi's official tutorial details how Kimi K3.1 Pro handles 3D creation via parametric and mesh modeling, walking through 4 cases—an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, a 3D-printable lamp, pure-code Blender architecture and a Tripo-plus-Blender miniature city—plus 5 tips like blocking out a grey model first.

stories.title: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户 / We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...

sources.title: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户 / We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.title_zh: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
sources.title_en: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.title_original: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.summary: Cursor 发现通过其 IDE 扩展市场分发的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被修改并植入恶意软件，最多影响 5000 用户，恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发。Cursor 已于当日下午下线扩展市场，与相关提供方合作清除恶意软件并确认无进一步风险后重新上线，建议受影响用户参考博客说明排查，并升级到 Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor IDE 扩展市场出现被篡改的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展，最多影响 5,000 名用户，该恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发，也不波及市场内其他扩展。

en.summary: Cursor discovered that the Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through its IDE extension marketplace had been tampered with and implanted with malware, affecting up to 5,000 users; the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic. Cursor took the marketplace offline that afternoon and restored it after working with the relevant providers to remove the malware and confirm there was no further risk. Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.
en.reason: A tampered Claude Code VS Code extension on Cursor's IDE marketplace carried malware, affected up to 5,000 users and was not developed by Anthropic; Cursor took the marketplace offline and urges upgrading to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

stories.title: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型 / How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model

sources.title: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型 / How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.title_zh: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型
sources.title_en: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.title_original: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.summary: Figma 介绍其为 agent 自研 Figma 编辑模型的训练方法，先用超过 25 万条合成样本做 SFT，让早期 Llama 3.3 70B 在编辑任务上接近当时顶级模型，后转向 RL 并结合确定性校验器与视觉评委做评测。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Figma 披露其设计编辑模型训练路径：先以 SFT 在超过 25 万示例上训练 Llama 3.3 70B，使其在当时编辑任务中可比顶尖模型，如今正加入 RL 提升泛化。

en.summary: Figma detailed how it trained its in-house Figma editing model for agents: it first used SFT on more than 250,000 synthetic samples, bringing an early Llama 3.3 70B close to the top models of the time on editing tasks, then shifted to RL and combined deterministic verifiers with a visual judge for evaluation.
en.reason: Figma trained an early Llama 3.3 70B on more than 250,000 synthetic examples via SFT to bring its design-editing tasks close to top models of the time, and now adds reinforcement learning with deterministic checkers and a vision judge for evaluation.

stories.title: Cursor 插件市场中的恶意 Claude Code 扩展试图远程访问并窃取数据 / Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft

sources.title: Cursor 插件市场中的恶意 Claude Code 扩展试图远程访问并窃取数据 / Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_zh: Cursor 插件市场中的恶意 Claude Code 扩展试图远程访问并窃取数据
sources.title_en: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.title_original: Malicious Claude Code extension in Cursor's marketplace attempted remote access and data theft
sources.summary:
A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinstated it after confirming there was no further risk.
A tampered Claude Code extension was live on the Cursor marketplace for about 11 hours, affecting up to 5,000 users. It tried to steal user data and set up remote access. Cursor took the entire marketplace offline and reinst
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 被篡改的 Claude Code 扩展在 Cursor 市场上线约 11 小时、波及多达 5,000 名用户，试图窃取主机名、用户名、操作系统和公网 IP 等数据并建立远程访问，Cursor 随后下架该扩展并短暂关停整个市场。

en.reason: A tampered Claude Code extension spent about 11 hours on the Cursor marketplace, reaching up to 5,000 users while trying to collect hostnames, usernames, operating systems and public IPs and establish remote access, prompting Cursor to take the marketplace offline.

stories.title: OpenAI 为已被证明难以控制的 AI 模型设定新行为准则 / OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control

sources.title: OpenAI 为已被证明难以控制的 AI 模型设定新行为准则 / OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.title_zh: OpenAI 为已被证明难以控制的 AI 模型设定新行为准则
sources.title_en: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.title_original: OpenAI sets new behavioral guidelines for AI models that have already proven hard to control
sources.summary:
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability. GPT models should now draw on conversation history to figure out what users actually want and disclose their own assumptions. Whether the models follow these rules is another matter.
OpenAI has updated its Model Spec, restructuring its AI behavior guidelines around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctabilit
sources.recommend_reason_zh: OpenAI将Model Spec重构为五项核心价值观，要求GPT结合记忆和过往对话推断需求并披露假设，自主agents不得阻止监督、纠正或关闭，但文章指出模型是否遵守仍存疑。

en.reason: OpenAI has restructured its Model Spec around five core values, including faithfulness to human intent and correctability, requiring GPT models to infer user intent from conversation history and disclose assumptions—though compliance remains unproven.

en.title: An AI trading framework with nearly 120,000 saves that replicates a full institutional investment research workflow.
en.summary:
An AI trading framework with nearly 120,000 saves replicates the full institutional investment research workflow!

TradingAgents is an AI financial research and trading decision framework that uses multiple LLM agents working together to simulate the full research, trading, and risk control process of professional institutions, and supports analysis of U.S. and A-share stocks and ETFs.

① Multi-dimensional market analysis
Four types of AI analysts separately complete: fundamentals (financial reports, valuation, earnings), technicals (RSI, MACD, price trends), market sentiment (news, Reddit sentiment), and macro (economic data, policy, major events) analysis.

② Multi-agent debate mechanism
Two groups of researchers, bullish and bearish, debate the same asset, weighing opportunities and risks to reduce the judgment bias of a single model.

③ AI trading decisions
The trading agent aggregates all research conclusions, gives buy/sell/hold recommendations, and outputs trading timing, position sizing, and investment logic...
en.reason: TradingAgents, an AI trading framework with nearly 120,000 bookmarks, assigns four AI analysts to fundamental, technical, sentiment and macro research, then has bull and bear researchers debate before a trading agent issues buy, sell or hold calls with timing, position sizing and rationale for US and A-share stocks and ETFs.

en.reason: Arrowspace S1's camera and LED let an AI model identify screw heads, recommend bit type and size, set safe torque, and light the matching slot in a 52-bit Smart Case, with kits about $79-$129 shipping April 2027.

stories.title: DSH Go：DeepSeek Harness 装进安卓手机，还能遥控电脑

sources.title: DSH Go：DeepSeek Harness 装进安卓手机，还能遥控电脑
sources.title_zh: DSH Go：DeepSeek Harness 装进安卓手机，还能遥控电脑
sources.title_original: DSH Go：DeepSeek Harness 装进安卓手机，还能遥控电脑
sources.summary: 火爆出圈的DSH Go，是社区打造的安卓端DSH客户端，免Root就能在手机本地跑Agent脚本，一键无缝接力电脑任务。除了支持任务中途插话调整需求，还可授权AI操控手机完成日程等操作，同时对支付、验证码等高风险行为也做了严格限制。一起上手试试，随时随地调度DeepSeek Harness处理代码、数据任务。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DSH Go 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进安卓手机，自带 Ubuntu 和 Node.js、免 Root，本机环境约占 1 GB，也能一键切到电脑端 DSH 接着跑任务。

en.title: DSH Go brings DeepSeek Harness to Android phones, plus remote PC control
en.summary: DSH Go is blowing up: a community-built Android client for DSH that runs Agent scripts locally on your phone without root, and hands off desktop tasks seamlessly with one tap. It lets you jump in mid-task to adjust requirements, and can be authorized to let the AI control the phone for things like calendar management, while strictly restricting high-risk actions such as payments and verification codes. Give it a try and put DeepSeek Harness to work on code and data tasks anytime, anywhere.
en.reason: DSH Go, a community-built Android client for DeepSeek Harness, runs Agent scripts without Root in a bundled Ubuntu and Node.js environment of about 1 GB, supports one-click handoff to desktop DSH and mid-task adjustments while restricting payment and verification-code actions.

sources.title: Suno 首次开放 MCP 接口：以后 AI 写歌不再依赖 Suno 官网
sources.title_zh: Suno 首次开放 MCP 接口：以后 AI 写歌不再依赖 Suno 官网
sources.title_original: Suno 首次开放 MCP 接口：以后 AI 写歌不再依赖 Suno 官网
sources.summary: Suno 开放了 MCP 内测，无需 API Key，授权后就能在 Claude、Cursor 等主流AI工具里直接调用作曲能力，彻底告别跨窗口复制文案的割裂创作流程。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Suno 首次开放 MCP：10月29日上线内测早鸟申请，Claude、ChatGPT 等无需 API Key、不写代码即可调用 Suno 写歌、改编、混音，扣现有套餐积分并存入音乐库。

en.title: Suno opens its MCP interface for the first time, so AI songwriting no longer has to go through Suno's website
en.summary: Suno has opened its MCP beta: no API key needed—just authorize and you can call its composition capabilities directly from mainstream AI tools like Claude and Cursor, ending the fragmented workflow of copying text across windows.
en.reason: Suno launched early-bird signups on October 29 for its first MCP beta, letting Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor users write, adapt and mix songs without an API key or code, deducting existing plan credits and saving tracks to their music library.

stories.title: 如何构建生产级 AI 智能体：模型与结果之间的 7 个层次（完整指南）

sources.title: 如何构建生产级 AI 智能体：模型与结果之间的 7 个层次（完整指南）
sources.title_zh: 如何构建生产级 AI 智能体：模型与结果之间的 7 个层次（完整指南）
sources.title_original: 如何构建生产级 AI 智能体：模型与结果之间的 7 个层次（完整指南）
sources.summary: 大多数智能体项目起步方式相同：最强的模型、长长的提示词、精彩的演示。随后真正的任务到来，一周之内你发现数字与源头不符、上下文丢失，有一天还出现一封未经任何人批准的客户邮件。一起来看看到底如何构建生产级智能体！
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以Anthropic 2025年6月“最后一英里往往占了整个旅程的大半”为引，拆解生产级AI智能体的7个层次，指出换模型很少奏效，并提及Viktor被70,000多个团队使用。

en.title: How to Build Production-Grade AI Agents: The 7 Layers Between Model and Outcome (Complete Guide)
en.summary: Most agent projects start the same way: the strongest model, long prompts, a great demo. Then real work arrives — and within a week the numbers don't match the source, context gets lost, and one day a customer email goes out that no one approved. Let's look at how to actually build production-grade agents.
en.reason: Building production-grade AI agents takes seven layers beyond a strong model and long prompt, because swapping models rarely works and the last mile can consume over half the journey, as Anthropic noted in June 2025.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 谷歌研究人员开源 EnvHarness，可不改智能体、环境与评估逻辑，动态调整训练环境，使多个模型在 WebArena 等基准上提升 2.9 到 3.7 个百分点。

en.title: Google launches EnvHarness to support dynamic environment learning for self-evolving agents
en.reason: Google researchers open-sourced EnvHarness, a lightweight framework that dynamically mutates static training environments via setup/rule/link interfaces without modifying the agent, environment or evaluation logic, lifting multiple models by 2.9 to 3.7 points on benchmarks such as WebArena.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Lightpanda 是从零用 Zig 编写的无头浏览器，不是 Chromium 分支或 WebKit 补丁，宣称比 Chromium 轻 16 倍、快 9 倍，并在 AWS EC2 m5.large 上实测抓取 933 个真实网页，值得读其面向 AI 与自动化的实现。

en.reason: Written from scratch in Zig rather than as a Chromium fork or WebKit patch, Lightpanda claims 16x lighter and 9x faster than Chromium and benchmarked scraping 933 real pages on AWS EC2 m5.large for AI and automation.

en.reason: A classifier’s valuation jumped from $200 million to $7.5 billion in 24 days—a blockchain-style mania contrasted with the dot-com bust because fiber lasts decades while GPUs become obsolete in about three years, asking who pays when it bursts.

sources.title: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制

sources.title_original: AI Infra进阶：3万字深入理解线性注意力机制
sources.summary: 这篇文章深度拆解了线性注意力从 DeltaNet、GDN 到 KDA 的演进脉络，同时落地到 vLLM 里 Hybrid 混合模型的缓存工程实现，帮你看懂模型架构和推理调度之间的软硬件取舍。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 3万字长文从Prefill/Decode访存差异讲到KVCache的O(N)瓶颈，并沿DeltaNet、GDN到KDA梳理线性注意力的Chunk-wise并行。

en.title: AI Infra Deep Dive: Understanding Linear Attention Mechanisms in 30,000 Words
en.summary: This article takes a deep dive into the evolution of linear attention from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA, then grounds it in the cache engineering behind hybrid models in vLLM, helping you understand the hardware-software trade-offs between model architecture and inference scheduling.
en.reason: Linear attention's evolution from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA is traced across a 30,000-character analysis that starts with Prefill/Decode memory-access differences and the O(N) KV Cache bottleneck, then lands in vLLM's Hybrid model cache implementation and Chunk-wise parallelism.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用三年 ProseMirror 经验推出 MSFE 源码优先 Markdown 编辑器框架，盘点 Notion、Obsidian、飞书等底层，指出 JSON 互转和两套编辑器切换会改写或丢失原文。

en.title: In the AI era, everyone's racing to build note-taking apps. I'd rather get the fundamentals of the Markdown editor right first.
en.reason: A ProseMirror developer with three years of experience introduces MSFE, a source-first Markdown editor framework, arguing that mainstream tools like Notion, Obsidian and Feishu store content as JSON or split WYSIWYG from source mode, rewriting or losing the original text on every conversion or switch.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Reddit CEO Steve Huffman宣布转向登录才能浏览，并将在美国以外市场测试登录要求；因Google AI Mode和AI Overviews，10月每周搜索推荐减少超100万次，日活用户或从约1.3亿下降低双位数百分比。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章追踪 ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude 和 Google AI Overviews 引用的1,285条统计，发现仅40%到达结论相同的研究，8%数字或语境已变，40%来源无法核查、11%无出处。

en.title: Zombie Data: Where Do the Numbers AI Cites Come From?
en.reason: Tracing 1,285 statistics cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Google AI Overviews across 200 numeric questions found only 40% led to research supporting the same conclusion, while 40% were unverifiable and 11% had no source.
